name: Sniperbot: The Hype Game
description:
About This Game

SNIPERBOT: THE HYPE GAME is a retro-inspired action platformer that plunges players into the neon-soaked, Hip-Hop cybertech realm of Meta Metro. In a city overrun by Hypebeasts, and clout is currency, survival demands mastery of your weapons, endurance through relentless enemy swarms, and victory in epic boss battles. Keep your eye on the target and Snipe the Hype!

  • Blaster and Blade Combat
    Swap seamlessly between ranged and melee attacks to handle threats with speed, precision, and style.

  • Unlockable Beast Modes (Skill-Swap System)
    Defeat Hypebeast Generals to earn unique super abilities called Beast Modes, which you can equip and swap mid-mission to suit your playstyle.

  • Combo-Ready Combat Feel
    A responsive combat system lets you fluidly link attacks and abilities into satisfying chains, creating a fast, expressive flow that rewards both precision and style.

  • Focused, Replayable Campaign
    A handcrafted, high-impact adventure packed with build variety, secret paths, and stylish encounters, delivering pure gameplay with no filler.

  • Over-the-Top Boss Battles
    Go head-to-head with viral Hypebeast icons, each with their own arena, patterns, and cinematic flair.

  • Fresh Aesthetic Identity
    The game combines the fun of retro action platforming gameplay with the aesthetics of sneaker and Hypebeast culture, brought to life with bold 3D visuals and late ‘80s / early ‘90s Hip-Hop energy.

Tight Platforming Inspired by Genre Greats

Navigate intricate levels designed for fast, responsive controls, featuring smooth wall-jumps, chainable dashes, vertical challenges, and hidden routes that reward skill and exploration.
short_desc: SNIPERBOT: THE HYPE GAME is a retro styled action platformer where the player traverses through the cybertech world of Meta Metro where Hypebeasts run wild, clout is currency and the only way to survive is attacking your enemies and fighting boss battles with a blaster and sword.
